stories.title: Kampf gegen Inflation – US-Notenbank Fed geht auf Distanz zu Trump

en.title: Fighting inflation – US Federal Reserve distances itself from Trump
en.summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh raised interest rates to signal independence from Trump's pressure for lower rates. The move demonstrates the central bank's commitment to combating inflation despite political opposition.

stories.title: Das Fed verschärft den Kampf gegen die Inflation und erhöht erstmals seit drei Jahren den Leitzins

en.title: The Fed tightens its fight against inflation and raises its key interest rate for the first time in three years
en.summary: The U.S. Federal Reserve increased its benchmark interest rate for the first time in three years to combat inflation, a move financial markets had anticipated. The decision puts the Fed at odds with Donald Trump, who has called for lower interest rates.

stories.title: Malgré la pression de Donald Trump, la Fed augmente ses taux d'intérêt

en.title: Despite pressure from Donald Trump, the Fed raises its interest rates
en.summary: The US Federal Reserve unanimously decided to increase interest rates to combat inflation, a move anticipated by financial markets but opposed by President Trump.

stories.title: La Fed relève ses taux malgré les pressions de Donald Trump, une nouvelle hausse est attendue d’ici fin 2026

en.title: The Fed raises its rates despite pressure from Donald Trump, with another increase expected by end of 2026
en.summary: The US Federal Reserve unanimously raised benchmark rates by a quarter point to combat ongoing inflation at 3.7 percent, defying White House expectations despite Trump's opposition to rate increases.

stories.title: Le nouveau modèle d'assurance 'hôpital de confiance': "Il faudra juger sur pièces", estime Simon Zurich

en.title: The new 'trusted hospital' insurance model: "We must judge by results", says Simon Zurich
en.summary: Assura and a hospital group launched a new insurance model promising lower premiums and better coordinated care. A patient representative acknowledged positive aspects but said it is premature to assess whether the promises will be fulfilled.

stories.title: Helene Budliger Artieda, agente très spéciale au service de l’économie

en.title: Helene Budliger Artieda, special agent in the service of the economy
en.summary: A state secretary for the economy has departed under unclear circumstances during critical negotiations on bilateral agreements with the European Union, raising concerns about whether outspoken officials are welcomed in federal administration.

stories.title: Le départ surprise d’Helene Budliger Artieda secoue la Berne fédérale

en.title: Helene Budliger Artieda's surprise departure shakes federal Bern
en.summary: The director of the State Secretariat for the Economy announced her resignation effective end of March 2027, causing shock given her key role in negotiations with Washington over trade rights and leaving many questions unanswered about her departure.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran wirft den propalästinensischen Rapper Macklemore aus der Tour – und wird dann von der Musikszene abgestraft

en.title: Ed Sheeran removes pro-Palestinian rapper Macklemore from tour – and is then punished by the music scene
en.summary: A pop star removed a supporting act from his tour after the performer made anti-Israel statements during opening performances, despite the artist's intention to keep politics out of his concerts.

stories.title: Trois morts dans le crash d’un avion léger contre une falaise à Loèche-les-Bains

en.title: Three dead in light aircraft crash against cliff at Loèche-les-Bains
en.summary: A Cirrus SR22T aircraft crashed into a cliff in the Fluhalp region on Tuesday afternoon, killing all three occupants. The plane had departed from Lugano airport and stopped in Sion before the accident.

stories.title: Schlüsselrolle im Zollstreit – «Achte Bundesrätin»: Seco-Chefin Helene Budliger tritt zurück

en.title: Key role in tariff dispute – "Eighth federal councillor": Seco chief Helene Budliger steps down
en.summary: State Secretary Helene Budliger Artieda is resigning at the end of March 2027. A search committee will oversee the process of finding her successor.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Die Seco-Chefin Helene Budliger Artieda geht – und das ist ein Verlust für die Schweiz

en.title: COMMENTARY - Seco chief Helene Budliger Artieda is departing – and that is a loss for Switzerland
en.summary: The departure of the Seco chief represents a loss for Switzerland, which relies on strong state secretaries to compensate for having the world's weakest government structure.

stories.title: Après trente ans à Bulle, la pharma belge UCB continue d’investir en Suisse mais se tourne aussi davantage vers les Etats-Unis

en.title: After thirty years in Bulle, Belgian pharma UCB continues to invest in Switzerland but also increasingly turns towards the United States
en.summary: Belgian pharmaceutical company UCB celebrates 30 years of operations in Bulle, where it employs over 850 people at a major manufacturing site. The company announced a new investment exceeding 100 million francs in 2025 while simultaneously expanding its presence in the United States.

stories.title: KURZMELDUNGEN - Wirtschaft: Frankreich und Italien reagieren auf hohe Kraftstoffpreise +++ Michael Kremer wird neuer Weltbank-Chefvolkswirt

en.title: BRIEFS - Economy: France and Italy respond to high fuel prices +++ Michael Kremer becomes new World Bank chief economist
en.summary: France and Italy are responding to elevated fuel prices. Michael Kremer has been appointed as the World Bank's new chief economist.

en.title: The Fed tightens its fight against inflation and raises its key interest rate for the first time in three years
en.summary: The U.S. Federal Reserve increased its benchmark interest rate for the first time in three years to combat inflation, a move financial markets had anticipated. The decision puts the Fed at odds with Donald Trump, who has called for lower interest rates.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Russland will Europa spalten – deshalb ist ein europäischer Sicherheitsrat eine gute Idee

en.title: COMMENTARY - Russia wants to divide Europe – that's why a European security council is a good idea
en.summary: Ursula von der Leyen proposes rethinking EU security architecture amid NATO tensions. However, such consultations will lack impact without credible deterrence capabilities.

stories.title: Bundespräsident Parmelin verliert seine wichtigste Beamtin: Die Seco-Chefin Helene Budliger tritt ab

en.title: Federal President Parmelin loses his most important civil servant: Seco chief Helene Budliger steps down
en.summary: Helene Budliger, secretary of state at the economics ministry, is stepping down. She was known for handling sensitive tasks, including involvement in tariff negotiations.

stories.title: Die OECD rüttelt am Schweizer Mietrecht

en.title: The OECD challenges Swiss rental law
en.summary: Switzerland faces worsening housing shortages. The OECD criticizes both slow housing construction and existing rent regulations, recommending reforms likely to spark political debate.
